name: Constellation Energy Corporation
thesis: Largest U.S. nuclear fleet operator with direct data-center PPAs; output is scarcer as AI load grows.
key_risk: PPA repricing at renewal; nuclear regulatory events.

name: Digital Realty Trust, Inc.
thesis: Global data-center REIT with land and power in constrained metros; benefits from AI-driven absorption.
key_risk: Rate sensitivity as a REIT; development pipeline execution.

name: Equinix, Inc.
thesis: Interconnection-centric colocation platform expanding into AI-dense capacity with xScale joint ventures.
key_risk: Capital intensity of xScale expansion; REIT rate sensitivity.

name: Eaton Corporation plc
thesis: Electrical power management leader; switchgear and transformers are the bottleneck goods of grid buildout.
key_risk: Order-book digestion if data-center capex pauses; price competition in commoditized lines.

name: GE Vernova Inc.
thesis: Gas-turbine, grid-equipment, and electrification backlog is levered to AI power generation buildout.
key_risk: Gas-turbine supply chain constraints; backlog conversion timing.

name: Modine Manufacturing Company
thesis: Data-center cooling segment (Airedyne) grows with liquid-cooling adoption in AI deployments.
key_risk: Customer concentration in hyperscale cooling; component cost inflation.

name: NextEra Energy, Inc.
thesis: Regulated utility with the largest renewables pipeline; data-center load growth flows through rate base.
key_risk: Rate-case outcomes; interest-rate sensitivity of its development pipeline.

name: Oklo Inc.
thesis: Fast-reactor developer with data-center offtake agreements; pre-revenue optionality on SMR deployments.
key_risk: NRC licensing timeline; pre-revenue financing needs.

name: Quanta Services, Inc.
thesis: Specialty infrastructure contractor for transmission and data-center interconnection work.

name: Symbotic Inc.
thesis: Warehouse-automation AI systems with a concentrated greenfield backlog and hyperscale customers.

name: Vertiv Holdings Co
thesis: Pure-play data-center power and cooling infrastructure; direct beneficiary of AI rack density.
key_risk: Hyperscaler capex timing; competition in liquid cooling.

name: Vistra Corp.
thesis: Integrated generation-and-retail platform levered to ERCOT power demand from data centers.
